exposure: Control cases (cesarean section and planned hysterectomy)
outcome: B1R expression in uterine smooth muscle cells, vascular endothelial cells, and neutrophils
cohort: Women who delivered uterine samples for analysis between 2012 and 2017
finding: The study found a positive correlation between up-regulated expression of bradykinin receptor type 1 (B1R) in the myometrium and increased uterine interstitial edema in women with postpartum acute myometritis (PAM).
